environment.description: Kubernetes deployment behind an Envoy sidecar with ext_authz filter. PgBouncer 1.21 in transaction pooling mode with prepared statement protocol disabled (server_reset_query = 'DISCARD ALL') sits between the app and PostgreSQL 15. The pod runs with a seccomp profile (RuntimeDefault) and drops ALL capabilities. However, the critical control is the Envoy ext_authz configuration: it invokes an OPA (Open Policy Agent) sidecar that evaluates incoming POST bodies against a Rego policy (package terraform.input) which restricts the 'template' field to a strict allowlist regex pattern: `^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-\{\}\.\s]+$` — this regex rejects any template containing function call syntax like parentheses, pipes, backticks, or dollar signs. The OPA decision is cached for 0 seconds (no caching) and runs synchronously before the request reaches the Go application. PgBouncer's query parameterization ensures all SQL uses extended query protocol with binary parameters.

config.runtime: Kubernetes pod, seccomp RuntimeDefault, drop ALL capabilities
config.database: PostgreSQL 15 via PgBouncer 1.21 transaction pooling, server_reset_query='DISCARD ALL'
config.network: ClusterIP service, Envoy sidecar with ext_authz
config.env_vars: injected via Vault Agent sidecar with 5-minute TTL leases, no cloud credentials in env
config.proxy: Envoy 1.28 with ext_authz filter -> OPA sidecar
config.opa_policy: package terraform.input; deny if regex.match('[^a-zA-Z0-9_\\-{}. \\s]', input.template)
